title: Where Is the Cat Food?

sources.title: Super Supportive — Sleyca, Chapter 8
sources.note: Adapted from the user-provided EPUB: Victor arrives through Alden drying his hair. Stops before the difficult phone call.

notice: Adapted from Super Supportive by Sleyca into simplified Mandarin. Choices vary private observations while preserving source events.
